title: 第0009章 售卖灵米灵药血参第0010章 种植血参意外来客
slug: 五灵根修炼慢我有百倍灵药空间

“灵米？”
看到陆青禾的摊位，旁边的几个杂役惊呼。
灵米放在外门弟子中算不得什么，可是对杂役弟子来说是难得的宝物。
几个杂役围了过来，看着露出的灵米。
“真的是灵米，传闻灵米可以加快修炼速度，外门弟子为什么比我们修炼速度快，不仅仅是灵根比我们好，还有就是每天都能够吃灵米。”
全部人眼神火热，对任何修士来说，能够增加修炼速度的东西都是可遇不可求的。
特别是他们这些杂役，如果能够将修为提升到炼气四层，就可以进入外门，享受宗门的福利。
修炼争的是时间，修炼越快，能够达到的成就越高，不然等到了五十岁还在炼气三层，到时候气血亏败，再想进一步是几乎不可能的事情。
陆青禾看围过来的人越来越多，炼气二层的修为暴露出来。
这让围观的人眼中闪过一丝忌惮。
炼气二层，在杂役弟子之中已经算得上是很强的实力了，在这里炼气三层寥寥无几。
更何况真的打起来，炼气三层也不可能说有完全碾压的实力。
这也是为什么要等到炼气二层陆青禾才来交易区的原因。
一名炼气二层的杂役弟子好奇的问道：“这位师兄，不知道你这灵米是从哪里弄来的？”
嘶哑的声音从面罩之下传来：“我是灵米种植弟子，这是我数年积累下来的灵米，要不是近期打算买一颗丹药突破修为，要不然我也舍不得拿出来。”
全部人立刻露出尊敬的眼神，炼气二层突破就是炼气三层了，炼气三层在杂役弟子中算得上是凤毛麟角的存在了。
而且能够在炼气二层就可以接到灵田任务，这都是那些有背景的杂役弟子才能够获得的福利。
普通杂役弟子想都不要想。
陆青禾对着炼气二层修士问道：“师弟要不要购买，只需要五块灵石？”

炼气二层修士很是心动，但是无奈摇摇头：“师兄说笑了，我哪有灵石购买灵米，灵石对我们杂役弟子来说是稀缺货。”
周围的人很是认同，他们一年运气好能够获得一两枚灵石都算是不错的。
更多的只是刚好完成宗门任务，根本没有多少时间，也没有实力去赚取灵石。
陆青禾愣了一下，他没有想到杂役弟子竟然这样穷，炼气二层连五块灵石都弄不到。
想了一下，炼气二层修士小心翼翼的拿出一柄破碎的长刀。
“师兄，我这里有一件破碎的下品法器，还能够发挥出下品法器一成威能，不知道可否兑换师兄的灵米。”
全部人用鄙夷的眼神看向二层炼气修士，一柄破碎的下品法器，价值最多一块灵石，而且还不知道能发挥几次作用。
被众人当猴一样看，炼气二层修士气急败坏的瞪了众人一眼。
“我又没说要兑换全部灵米，十五斤就行，真不行，十二斤也可以。”
陆青禾目光看向破碎长刀，法器他还是第一次见到。
衡量一个修士的实力，修为法力，术法，法器缺一不可。
不过陆青禾并不打算交易，他虽然不知道这破碎法器多少价格，但是看起来和十二斤灵米不匹配。
最关键是他炼气二层，也发挥不了法器的作用，更何况还只是破碎的法器。

"Lingmi?"
Seeing Lu Qinghe's stall, several handymen nearby exclaimed.
Spirit rice is nothing among the outer disciples, but it is a rare treasure for the handyman disciples.
Several handymen gathered around and looked at the exposed spiritual rice.
"It's really spiritual rice. It is said that spiritual rice can speed up cultivation. Why are the outer disciples practicing faster than us? Not only are their spiritual roots better than ours, but they can also eat spiritual rice every day."
Everyone's eyes were fiery. For any monk, anything that can increase the speed of cultivation is rare.
Especially these handymen, if they can improve their cultivation to the fourth level of Qi Refining, they can enter the outer sect and enjoy the benefits of the sect.
Cultivation competes for time. The faster you practice, the higher the achievements you can achieve. Otherwise, when you are fifty years old and you are still at the third level of Qi refining, your Qi and blood will be exhausted, and it will be almost impossible to go further.
Lu Qinghe saw that more and more people were gathering around him, and his cultivation at the second level of Qi Refining was exposed.
This made the onlookers have a flash of fear in their eyes.
The second level of Qi Refining is already considered very powerful among the handyman disciples, but there are very few who are on the third level of Qi Refining here.
What's more, if they really fight, it is impossible to say that the third level of Qi Refining has the strength to completely crush them.
This was also the reason why he had to wait until Lu Qinghe, who was on the second level of Qi Refining, came to the trading area.
A handyman disciple on the second level of Qi Refining asked curiously: "Senior brother, I wonder where you got this spiritual rice from?"
A hoarse voice came from under the mask: "I am a spiritual rice cultivation disciple. This is the spiritual rice I have accumulated over the years. If I hadn't planned to buy a pill to break through my cultivation in the near future, I would not have been willing to take it out."
Everyone immediately showed respect in their eyes. The breakthrough to the second level of Qi Refining was the third level of Qi Refining. The third level of Qi Refining was considered rare among the handyman disciples.
Moreover, you can receive spiritual field missions on the second level of Qi Refining. This is a benefit that only those handyman disciples with background can obtain.
Ordinary handyman disciples don’t even think about it.
Lu Qinghe asked the second-level Qi Refining monk: "Junior brother, do you want to buy it? You only need five spiritual stones?"
The second-level Qi Refining monk was very moved, but shook his head helplessly: "Senior brother is joking, I don't have the spiritual stone to buy spiritual rice. Spiritual stone is a scarce commodity for us handyman disciples."
People around them agreed that it was considered good if they were lucky enough to get one or two spiritual stones a year.
Most of them just happened to complete the sect's mission, and they didn't have much time or strength to earn spiritual stones.
Lu Qinghe was stunned for a moment. He didn't expect that the handyman disciples were so poor. They couldn't even get five spiritual stones on the second level of Qi Refining.
After thinking for a moment, the second-level Qi Refining monk carefully took out a broken long knife.
"Senior brother, I have a broken low-grade magic weapon here. It can still exert 10% of the power of the low-grade magic weapon. I wonder if I can exchange it for spiritual rice from senior brother."
Everyone looked at the second-level Qi Refining monk with disdain. A broken low-grade magic weapon was worth at most one spiritual stone, and it was unknown how many times it could be used.
Being looked at like a monkey by everyone, the second-level Qi Refining monk glared at everyone angrily.
"I didn't say that I want to exchange all the spiritual rice. Just fifteen kilograms will be fine. If it doesn't work, twelve kilograms will be fine."
Lu Qinghe looked at the Broken Long Knife. This was the first time he had seen the magical weapon.
To measure a monk's strength, cultivation, magic, and magic weapons are all indispensable.
However, Lu Qinghe did not intend to trade. Although he did not know the price of the broken magic weapon, it did not seem to match the twelve kilograms of spiritual rice.
The most important thing is that even at the second level of Qi Refining, he can't play the role of the magic weapon, not to mention it's just a broken magic weapon.
